title: Connection budget: reduce to two evaluators
notes: A clean 6.3 hour interval at three evaluators measured 0.1436 of connection budget per day against an allowance of 0.1092, projecting 5.38 against a limit of 5. Three is over; two is not.
This is the tier ladder working as intended: the tool measured the current configuration rather than extrapolating from another, found it unaffordable, and named the fallback.

demo-orders on Production and Staging retains demo-email-notifications-v2 in both critical environments plus all three false-silence controls, so the surviving archive candidate can still complete rollout, code removal, drain and a provable silence window.
demo-checkout stops, so demo-tax-calculation-v2 pauses at thirty per cent until the September allowance resets. Its code references and flag identity are untouched.
